findings.issue_category: missing key rotation and overly permissive default policy
findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), and no explicit key policy is defined, which means AWS applies the default key policy granting full access (kms:*) to the account root, effectively allowing any IAM principal with IAM permissions to use or manage this key. For an audit trail encryption key, this weakens the intended access control and increases risk of unauthorized key usage or key policy tampering.
